items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: They weren't me regular, I could have played with Poise Humphrey there

ctx.x: I just wondered if you'd ever played any regular brass bands or just a few filled in a few dates?
Just filled in me there was no regular. They weren't me regular, I could have played with Poise Humphrey there, what is it Tuxedo is there?
